description: This file defines the ClientObserverPlacementStrategyResolver class, which implements the IPlacementStrategyResolver interface to resolve placement strategies for grains in Orleans based on whether they are clients.

classes.name: ClientObserverPlacementStrategyResolver
classes.description: Implements strategy resolution for client observer grains, determining if a grain should use the ClientObserversPlacement strategy.

methods.name: TryResolvePlacementStrategy
methods.description: Attempts to resolve and assign the appropriate placement strategy for a given grain type, returning true if successful.
